name: Price Chopper Receipt
description: Price Chopper retail receipt issued from Store 36 located at 6475 N. Prospect in Gladstone, Missouri (ZIP 64119). The receipt includes store branding at the header along with management attribution to the store director and a customer feedback notice. POS metadata includes store number, register number, lane identifier, cashier ID, cashier name, authorization number, reference/sequence number, and ticket number. The receipt displays a financial summary with balance due, cash tendered, and change calculation, along with activation and ending balance lines typical of gift card transactions. A transaction timestamp appears in both short POS format and full ticket timestamp format. The footer section records cashier identification, register details, and additional POS tracking numbers. The format reflects a grocery and supermarket retail point-of-sale receipt used for prepaid card activations.
